**Summary of changes:**

| Pages Router | App Router |
|--------------|------------|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` with metadata API |
| `pages/index.js` + `getServerSideProps` | `app/page.tsx` (Server Component with `headers()`) |
| `pages/blog/index.js` + `getStaticProps` | `app/blog/page.tsx` (ISR via `next: { revalidate: 60 }`) |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` + `getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps` | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` + `generateStaticParams()` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` (GET/POST handlers) |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (GET/PUT/DELETE handlers) |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` (client component with `useEffect`) |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` (with types) |
| `next/router` (useRouter) | `next/navigation` (useRouter) |
| `Head` from `next/head` | `metadata` export + `generateMetadata` |
